recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a smiling man in a black cowboy hat and textured white shirt, set against a weathered, blue industrial structure with diagonal beams and distressed paint textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, looking toward the left
Diagonal industrial beams creating a dynamic background frame
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial features and shirt texture
Distressed, weathered overlays unifying the subject and background
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat with a wide brim
Weathered blue paint on metal background
Gritty, film-grain or scratched-metal texture overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right half of the frame in a medium close-up; head is near the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright white smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the typography on the left, then follow the diagonal blue beams downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame provides space for typography, filled with dark shadows and industrial details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and blacks in the background and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and cream tones in the shirt and teeth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and subtle green foliage peeking through background gaps.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright shirt and dark hat/background; saturation is muted to enhance a rugged feel.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy, distressed slab serif with spur-like details
Secondary text uses a clean, bold, wide sans-serif
Horizontal alignment with slight overlap between lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges and internal texture to mimic weathered paint
Elongated vertical strokes on the primary display text

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned to the left margin of display text

treatment.shadow: outer glow or shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed western-style slab serif paired with a modern, clean wide sans-serif for contrast between tradition and contemporary style.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the weathered, western slab-serif aesthetic.
Provides the wide, sturdy sans-serif feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a smiling man with dark hair wearing a black cowboy hat and a textured white thermal shirt. Place him on the right side of the frame. The background should be a weathered, blue-painted industrial metal structure with diagonal beams and dark shadows. Apply a heavy distressed texture with scratches and film grain over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, distressed white slab-serif font on the left-center. Directly below it, add a subtitle in a bold, wide, clean white sans-serif font. Ensure the text has a subtle drop shadow to separate it from the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned on the right?
Does the background feature blue diagonal industrial beams?
Is the main text distressed and slab-serif?
Is the overall texture gritty and weathered?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue in the background
Amount of distress/scratches in the overlay
Specific texture of the white shirt
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any unique sleeve tattoos or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cowboy hat is solid black and well-defined.
Check that the blue background beams are clearly diagonal.
Verify the text is legible despite the distressed effect.
Confirm the subject's shirt has a visible crinkled or thermal texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged male portrait in western attire with a high-contrast, blue-toned industrial background and distressed slab-serif typography for a modern country aesthetic.
